ValidationRule.description: This rule triggers when Case Category is left blank if status value is either Validated , In progress or Assigned .
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISCHANGED( IME_SC_Owner_Manager__c )), NOT(ISCHANGED( IME_SC_Manager_of_Manager_OwnerId__c )), $RecordType.Name = "IME SC Case" , ISPICKVAL(IME_SC_Category__c, ""), OR( OR( ISPICKVAL(Status, "Validated") , ISPICKVAL(Status, "Assigned") , ISPICKVAL(Status, "In Progress")), OR( AND(ISPICKVAL(IME_SC_Closure_Reason__c, "Completed"), OR(ISPICKVAL(Status, "Closed"), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Resolved")))) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please enter the value of Case Category .
